name: 陳雅玫
objective: This beginning-level ESP (English for specific purposes) course is designed to develop students’ essential English communication skills for the workplace. Through activities related to résumé writing, business communication, job interviews, briefings, and office conversations, students will receive integrated training in the four language skills: listening, speaking, reading, and writing. The course will also strengthen their foundational language knowledge and skills, including vocabulary, grammar, and sentence construction.
